_comment: Who may open which guide. Each audience's password is a Cloudflare secret, named below (the name, never the password). List audiences from least to most privileged: a password that matches several opens the first. 谁可以打开哪份导览：每个受众的密码是 Cloudflare 里的一个 secret，这里只写它的名字，不写密码。受众按权限从低到高排列。See docs/GUIDES.md.
